name: Heading Link Sync
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Opens a free source list from a heading or block reference count.
Preserves unsaved text when updating links in open notes.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Clicking a heading or block reference count opens a free list of its sources.
Unsaved text in open notes is kept when links are updated.
tip: Leave a retyped heading or stop typing for 1.5 seconds to update its links.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Heading Link Sync is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your links working.
